plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner: the can anchors the left edge, logo and headline/subhead share one left-aligned column in the middle, and a generously sized CTA closes the read on the right at the column's vertical centre.

Message first: logo and headline stack left-aligned on the left half, the can sits between message and action as the visual bridge, and the CTA sits on the far right, so the eye goes brand, headline, product, action.

Brand-product-pitch triptych: the logo lockup sits as a brand block on the far left, the can follows, and the right half holds a tight copy block with the CTA directly under the headline and subhead, sharing their left edge as one grouped call to action.
